summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, announcing the signing of a Reorganization Agreement and the mailing of materials for a Special Meeting of Shareholders to approve a proposed reorganization. Under the plan, Versa Bancorp, a new holding company, will become the direct or indirect parent of VersaBank and its U.S. subsidiary, and will succeed VersaBank as the publicly traded entity. The Board unanimously recommends shareholders vote in favor. The Special Meeting is scheduled for September 16, 2026, for shareholders of record as of August 10, 2026. The SEC declared the related Registration Statement effective on August 4, 2026. The reorganization, while not a classic going-private transaction, involves a structural change where existing shareholders receive equity in Versa Bancorp, but the nature of the exchange and any premium or specific terms were not detailed in the excerpt. The press release emphasizes the importance of shareholder voting, but provides no breakup fee, per-share consideration, or premium details. Watch for shareholders' concerns about the post-reorganization share terms and any potential dissenting votes or regulatory conditions.
